rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when evidence is used to establish that a claim is true.

example.english: These documents are enough to substantiate what he said.
example.traditional: 呢啲文件足以證明佢講嘅係真嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 man4 gin6 zuk1 ji5 zing3 ming4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this when evidence confirms that an allegation, report, or other claim is in fact true.

example.english: The investigation report was enough to substantiate the allegation that someone had tampered with the data.
example.traditional: 份調查報告足以證實有人篡改過數據。
example.jyutping: fan2 diu6 caa4 bou3 gou3 zuk1 ji5 zing3 sat6 jau5 jan4 saan3 goi2 gwo3 sou3 geoi3
